mapper.select: SELECT id,rule_code,rule_name name,category,default_severity level,is_enabled enabled,version_status,trigger_expression,recovery_expression,routing_config,cooldown_minutes,version,owner_team,priority FROM t_alert_rule WHERE version_status IN ('ACTIVE','SHADOW') ORDER BY priority,id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(priority),0)+10 FROM t_alert_rule WHERE version_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_alert_rule(rule_code,rule_name,category,owner_team,priority,version,version_status,default_severity,trigger_expression,recovery_expression,routing_config,cooldown_minutes,is_enabled) VALUES(#{row.ruleCode},#{row.name},'BUSINESS',#{row.ownerTeam},#{row.priority},#{row.version},'ACTIVE',#{row.level},CAST(#{row.triggerExpression} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.recoveryExpression} AS JSON),CAST(#{row.routingConfig} AS JSON),#{row.cooldownMinutes},#{row.enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT rule_code,version,is_enabled enabled,priority FROM t_alert_rule WHERE id=#{id} AND version_status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_rule SET version_status='RETIRED' WHERE id=#{id} AND version_status='ACTIVE'
UPDATE t_alert_rule SET is_enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id} AND version_status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_alert_rule WHERE version_status='ACTIVE' AND id IN #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_alert_rule SET priority=CASE id WHEN #{row.id} THEN #{row.priority} END WHERE id IN #{row.id}
mapper.select: SELECT rule_code FROM t_alert_rule WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT id,rule_code,rule_name FROM t_alert_rule WHERE id IN #{id}
